affected_boundaries: durable execution blocker report to existing-session continuation readiness

observed_behavior: An idle assigned worker with a present checkout was marked ready for continuation despite its unresolved ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED execution report.
expected_behavior: The continuation names the unresolved blocker and remains not ready until its prerequisite is repaired and the report is resolved.
causal_mechanism: Runnable-plan diagnostics read the durable report store, but continuation readiness was derived only from host and assignment diagnostics.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Two projections of actionability consumed different subsets of the same authoritative evidence.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The coordinator can wake an idle worker into a known, unchanged failure while believing the assignment is ready.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Every unresolved applicable execution report obstructs both runnable diagnostics and existing-session continuation readiness.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Select latest applicable reports once, then use that selection in both projections.

applicability_conditions: Durable unresolved report for that assignment
Waiting or completed original session with present managed checkout
known_non_matches: Report scoped to an action no longer pending
confirmation_evidence: Live GWEN API standalone continuation was ready while its durable ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED report remained unresolved.
Focused real-Git regression failed before the repair and passed after it.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: unfinished assignment continuation requires the original idle session and live checkout
